title: Egypt calculator readiness — Batch 47
purpose: Audit primary crop statistics, administrative regions, producer-price sources and farm-budget gaps before any calculator activation.

confirmed_findings.source: CAPMAS Crop Areas and Plant Production bulletin, December 2024
confirmed_findings.finding: 17.0 million feddans cropped area and 10.1 million feddans planted area; publication metadata identifies winter, summer and Nili seasons and governorate-level reporting.
confirmed_findings.qualification: Cropped area and planted area are distinct; these totals are not crop-specific yields.

confirmed_findings.finding: Official database interface provides year, land category and governorate selectors and planted/cropped area fields by winter, summer and Nili season.
confirmed_findings.qualification: No data rows were visible in accessible page text during this review; no numeric observations transcribed.

confirmed_findings.finding: Official interface distinguishes farm prices in EGP/tonne from traded prices in EGP/kg and filters by season, crop and year.
confirmed_findings.qualification: No dated observation rows were extracted; not yet usable as a calculator price.

confirmed_findings.finding: Daily database reports Obour wholesale and representative national retail min/max/average prices.
confirmed_findings.qualification: Wholesale and retail only; not producer/farm-gate prices.

confirmed_findings.finding: Egypt has 27 governorates grouped into seven broad regions.
confirmed_findings.qualification: Use governorates as primary regional selection units; seven regions are only a higher-level grouping.

confirmed_findings.finding: Official publication page lists national 2024 livestock and poultry statistics reports.
confirmed_findings.qualification: Regional enterprise costs and producer prices not extracted.

secondary_crosscheck_only.note: Previously captured wheat, maize, paddy-rice and tomato production values remain cross-check leads only; no yield admitted without matched area and season from primary data.

blockers: download and extract the CAPMAS 2023/24 workbook and/or MALR crop-composition database by crop, governorate and winter/summer/Nili season; reconcile planted, cropped and harvested area definitions
verify crop-specific multi-season yields for the calculator's 17 commodities; do not use national production-only totals or secondary transcriptions as yields
extract dated MALR farm-gate price records by crop, season and year, retaining EGP/tonne and distinguishing traded EGP/kg observations
obtain current farmer-paid seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, labour, machinery, irrigation-water, energy, land-rent and transport costs by governorate and production system
download and extract 2024 livestock and poultry reports and obtain region-specific enterprise costs and output prices
document governorate-to-seven-region mapping only as a grouping layer; preserve governorate and old-land/new-land/reclaimed production distinctions where supported
build crop-specific regional enterprise budgets, currency handling and calculator test cases before activation
decision: Do not activate Egypt. The official source infrastructure is promising, but actual regional crop observations, current farm-gate prices and full enterprise costs have not been extracted or validated. No calculator formulas or active country data changed.
next_step: Extract the CAPMAS/MALR crop and price database records, then build governorate-level budgets for each supported commodity and season.
